remarks:
Welcome to 8 Washington Street, Unit 303, a two-bedroom, one-bath condominium set within a historic landmark of the Ellicottville Inn in the heart of the village of Ellicottville. This single-level residence offers a flexible layout with the bedroom doors removed, opening the interior into a more expansive living area. Updated appliances add everyday convenience, while a new air-conditioning unit installed in 2025 supports year-round comfort and minimal utility costs. The building also received a new roof in 2024. 

From the condominium, enjoy what may be the best view of the village, with its lively streets and seasonal scenery just beyond your windows. Step outside and walk to local dining, shopping, entertainment, and village amenities. The Gin Mill and Ellicottville Brewing Company are nearby, while Holimont and Holiday Valley Resort place skiing, recreation, and four-season adventure within easy reach.

Practical extras make ownership even easier: two assigned parking spaces, two ski lockers, and an oversized storage unit provide ample room for vehicles, equipment, and personal belongings. Short-term rentals are permitted with the proper Village permit, presenting an appealing opportunity for potential rental income when you’re away. Whether envisioned as a weekend base, investment property, or village retreat, Unit 303 combines central access, useful storage, dedicated parking, and a front-row perspective on one of Western New York’s most inviting four-season destinations.
